Comprehension:Read the given passage carefully and answer the questions that follow.The Indus Valley Civilisation, which flourished around 2500 BCE, is regarded as one of the earliest urban societies in human history. Spanning parts of present-day India and Pakistan, it was remarkable for its advanced city planning, drainage systems, and standardised brick structures. Cities like Harappa and Mohenjo-Daro were laid out on a grid pattern, with wide streets and sophisticated public baths—features that reflected an organised and progressive society.Archaeologists have discovered seals, pottery, tools, and jewelry that reveal the artistic and commercial achievements of this civilisation. Trade links with Mesopotamia suggest that the Indus people had a well-developed system of exchange. Interestingly, the script used by them remains undeciphered even today, leaving many aspects of their language, beliefs, and governance shrouded in mystery.Around 1900 BCE, the civilisation began to decline, possibly due to environmental changes such as shifting river courses or repeated floods. Despite its fall, the Indus Valley left an enduring legacy of urban culture, technological skill, and social organisation. Its silent ruins continue to remind us that even in ancient times, human ingenuity could build cities of remarkable complexity and order, inspiring modern planners and historians to appreciate the sophistication and enduring wisdom of early civilisations and their contribution to human progress.Q76. Which feature shows that the Indus people were skilled city planners?
questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'A' (Grid-patterned streets and drainage systems) है।

Comprehension: Read the given passage carefully and answer the following questions.India could experience 30 fewer extremely hot days each year, while the world on average could avoid such 57 such days if countries meet their emission- cutting pledges under the 2015 Paris Agreement and limit global warming to 2.6 degrees Celsius this century, according to a new study published on Thursday.The analysis by Climate Central and World Weather Attribution said the global accord, which completes 10 years this year, is steering the world toward a safer climate but warned that the current pace of action is not enough. Even at 2.6 degree Celsius, scientists caution, future generations will face heat, severe health risks and growing inequality unless countries move faster to phase out fossil fuels. India could experience 30 fewer hot days a year, while Kenya could see 82 fewer, Mexico 77, Brazil 69, Egypt 36 and the US and the UK 30 and 29 respectively, the researchers said.Prof Friederike Otto, Professor in Climate Science at Imperial College London, said, “The Paris Agreement is a powerful, legally binding framework that can help us avoid the most severe impacts of climate change. However, countries need to more to shift away from oil, gas and coal. We have all the knowledge and technology needed to transition away from fossil fuels but stronger, fairer policies are needed to move faster.”“Political leaders need to take the reason for the Paris Agreement much more seriously. It is about protecting our human rights.” she added.What inference can be drawn about the current state of global climate action?
options: Future generations will face severe health risks only in countries that did not sign the Paris Agreement.
The Paris Agreement is failing and has had no measurable positive effect on global warming.
The recent international efforts have stabilized the climate, and no further action on fossil fuels is necessary.
While the Paris Agreement is effective, the rate at which countries are meeting the pledges is currently too slow to avoid serious long-term consequences.
questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'D' (While the Paris Agreement is effective, the rate at which countries are meeting the pledges is currently too slow to avoid serious long-term consequences.) है।

Comprehension:Read the given passage and answer the questions that follow.The evolution of communication technology has dramatically transformed how humans interact and share information. From the early days of written letters and telegraphs to today's instant messaging and video calls, the ways in which we communicate have undergone significant changes. In the 19th century, the invention of the telegraph revolutionised long-distance communication, allowing messages to be transmitted over wires in minutes rather than days. This breakthrough was followed by the telephone, invented by Alexander Graham Bell in 1876, which enabled real-time voice communication over long distances. The 20th century saw the advent of radio and television, which brought news, entertainment and educational content to a wide audience. These technologies played a crucial role in shaping public opinion and culture. The development of the internet in the late 20th century marked another significant milestone. The internet enabled instant access to vast amounts of information and facilitated new forms of communication such as email, forums and social media.In the 21st century, mobile technology and smartphones have taken communication to new heights. Smartphones combine multiple functions, including voice calls, text messaging, internet access and multimedia capabilities, in a single device. Social media platforms like Facebook, Twitter and Instagram have created virtual communities where people can connect, share experiences and express themselves. The impact of these advancements is profound. They have made communication faster, more efficient and more accessible. People can now communicate with others around the world instantly, fostering global connections and collaborations. However, these advancements also come with challenges. Issues such as digital privacy, misinformation and the digital divide have emerged as significant concerns. Ensuring that everyone has equal access to communication technology and addressing the ethical implications of its use are critical as we continue to advance. In conclusion, the evolution of communication technology has greatly enhanced our ability to connect and share information. As we move forward, it is essential to navigate the challenges and maximise the benefits of these innovations.What is one challenge associated with advancements in communication technology?

Comprehension:Read the given passage carefully and answer the questions that follow.Sunderban is the largest delta and mangrove forest in the world. The Indian Sunderban is bound on the west by river Muriganga and on the east by rivers Hariabhanga and Raimangal. Sunderban's highly productive ecosystem acts as a natural fish nursery. The biogeography of Sunderban is unique and the region harbours a rich diversity in terms of species content, ecosystem, and habitat types. This deltic ecosystem, which is the single largest continuous area in the world for the threatened Bengal Tiger and the largest contiguous mangrove-patch on the globe (along with Bangladesh), is very productive and well-known for its greater degree or specialisation. The entire Eastern India is dependent on the fishery resources from Sunderban. More than 40 species of mammals, 163 species of birds, 56 species of reptiles, 165 species of fish, 23 species of molluscs, 15 species of prawns, and 67 species of crabs have so far been reported in SBR, such as the hawk eagle (Nisaetus Sps.) and the south-water crocodile (Crocodylus porosus).Some three million people live in the biosphere reserve (2001). They depend directly on forest and forest-based resources since agriculture is not productive enough due to saline water. Sales of timber, fuel wood, thatching leaves, honey, and wax are the main sources of income. Due to demographic pressures, the Sunderban is under great stress and therefore an eco-development programme is envisaged based on a highly participative approach of the local communities.Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.

questions.question: Comprehension:Read the given passage carefully and answer the questions that follow.The mountain trail was challenging, with steep inclines and rocky paths. However, the breathtaking views at each turn made the effort worthwhile. Hikers could see for miles, taking in the lush forests, sparkling rivers, and distant snow-capped peaks. Birds of prey soared overhead, their calls echoing through the valleys. As the sun began to set, casting a golden hue over the landscape, the entire scene felt almost surreal. Cool mountain air filled their lungs, refreshing their tired bodies with each deep breath. Despite the physical exertion, there was a sense of tranquility that enveloped those who ventured into the wilderness, making them feel at peace with nature. Each step taken felt like a journey not only across the terrain but inward, as the serenity of the environment encouraged reflection and a deeper connection with the surrounding beauty.The rhythmic crunch of their boots on the earth was accompanied by the soothing rustle of leaves in the gentle evening breeze. In the distance, the first twinkling stars began to appear, hinting at the approaching night sky that would soon blanket the peaks. As they neared their resting point, the comforting crackle of a campfire awaited, promising warmth and companionship. The day's journey had left them physically weary but spiritually rejuvenated, as the wilderness offered both challenge and solace.What made the challenging mountain trail worthwhile for the hikers?

questions.question: Comprehension:Read the given passage and answer the questions that follow. Waxing, a common method of hair removal, has been practised for centuries across different cultures and civilisations. While its basic purpose remains cosmetic, the motivations and perceptions surrounding waxing have evolved significantly. In ancient Egypt, hair removal was considered a symbol of cleanliness and beauty. Today, waxing is both a personal grooming choice and, at times, a reflection of societal norms and expectations. Modern waxing techniques range from traditional hot wax to newer options like sugar waxing and cold wax strips. These methods vary in effectiveness, pain levels, and cost, making accessibility and preference important factors in decision-making. Interestingly, the popularity of waxing has also prompted discussions about gender roles and body autonomy. Although once marketed predominantly to women, waxing has seen a rise in male clientele in recent years, reflecting a shift toward more inclusive beauty standards. Despite its widespread use, waxing is not without its criticisms. Dermatologists often warn against overuse, as it can irritate the skin, lead to ingrown hairs, and even cause long-term sensitivity. Moreover, some argue that the pressure to remove body hair is driven more by commercial beauty ideals than by individual preference. Waxing is more than a grooming habit; it reveals the complex interplay between personal choices, cultural influences, and evolving ideals of beauty.Identify the ANTONYM of the word 'prompted' given in the passage.

Comprehension:Read the passage carefully and answer the questions that follow.Incorporating right-brain creative processes into traditionally left-brain-dominated fields such as engineering and finance can offer numerous benefits, but it also presents challenges that must be carefully managed. The benefits are innovation and problem-solving, Right-brain creative processes can drive innovation in engineering by encouraging engineers to explore unconventional solutions. For example, creative brainstorming might lead to the development of a more efficient design or a novel application of existing technology. In finance, creativity can lead to innovative financial products or strategies that differentiate a firm from its competitors. Enhanced Design Thinking, right-brain thinking, can improve the aesthetics and user experience of products. Engineers who engage in creative thinking might develop products that are not only functional but also visually appealing and user-friendly. In finance, creative thinking can lead to more engaging and effective communication of complex financial data, making it more accessible to clients. Improved adaptability and creative thinking help professionals in left-brain-dominated fields become more adaptable. For instance, engineers who are comfortable with creative processes may be better equipped to handle unexpected challenges or pivot when a project requires a new approach. Similarly, finance professionals who think creatively may be more adept at developing strategies to navigate market volatility. Successfully incorporating right-brain creative processes into these fields requires a balance between innovation and the rigorous standards that define these professions.Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the word 'adaptability' given in the passage.

दिए गए वाक्य के रेखांकित अंश में अशुद्धि है। नीचे दिए गए विकल्पों में से शुद्ध वर्तनी वाला शब्द चुनिए-महादेवी वर्मा रहस्यवादी कवित्री हैं।

Comprehension:दिए गये गाद्यंश को पढ़ें और नीचे दिए गये प्रश्नो का उत्तर देंमहात्मा ग़ाँधीजी का जन्म 2 अक्तूबर 1869 को  गुजरात के पोरबंदर में हुआ था। उनका पूरा नाम मोहनदास करमचंद ग़ाँधी था। उनके पिता का नाम करमचंद ग़ाँधी तथा  माता का नाम पुतलीबाई था। ग़ाँधीजी अपनी वकालत की पढ़ाई के लिए विदेश गये थे। वकालत की पढ़ाई पूरा करने के बाद ग़ाँधीजी ने  दक्षिण अफ्रीका में रह रहे भारतीय समुदाय के लोगों के मानवीय हक़ और अधिकार के लिए संघर्ष किया तथा उनका अधिकार दिलवाया। वहाँ से भारत लौटकर ग़ाँधीजी  अंग्रेजों से भारत को आजाद कराने की लड़ाई में उतर गये। ग़ाँधीजी सत्य  और अहिंसा के पुजारी थे। अंग्रेज उनके सत्य और अहिंसा के हथियार से डरते थे, इसलिए वे ग़ाँधीजी  को बार- बार जेल डाल देते थे। ग़ाँधीजी ने ‘सत्य के प्रयोग’ नाम से अपनी आत्मकथा लिखी है। रवीन्द्रनाथ टैगोर ने  ग़ाँधीजी को  ‘महात्मा’ की उपाधि प्रदान की। भारत को स्वतंत्र कराने में ग़ाँधीजी ने अपना सम्पूर्ण जीवन न्योछावर कर दिया। महात्मा ग़ाँधी को भारत का  राष्ट्रपिता कहा  जाता है। भारत में हर वर्ष  2 अक्तूबर को ग़ाँधी जयंती मनायी जाती है। तथा पूरे विश्व में 2 अक्तूबर को अंतरराष्ट्रीय अहिंसा दिवस मनाया जाता है। महात्मा ग़ाँधीजी की मृत्यु 30 जनवरी 1948 को गोली लगने से हुई थी।सही विकल्प का चयन कीजिये .
महात्मा गाँधी का जन्म हुआ था ?
questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'D' (2 अक्टूबर सन् 1869) है।

questions.question: निम्नलिखित वाक्यों में उनके प्रथम तथा अन्तिम अंश संख्या 1 और 6 के अन्तर्गत दिए गए हैं। बीच वाले चार अंश (य), (र), (ल), (व) के अन्तर्गत बिना क्रम के हैं। चारों अंशों को उचित क्रमानुसार व्यवस्थित कर सही विकल्य चुनें -(1) प्रतियोगिता में भेजे गए फोटो(य) अवश्य भेजें ताकि फोटो अस्वीकृत(र) के साथ उचित आकार का, पर्याप्त ठीक (ल) होने पर उसे वापस भेजा जा सके, वरना अस्वीकृत(व) टिकट लगा और अपने पते वाला लिफाफा(6) फोटो वापस नहीं भेजा जायेगा।
questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'A' (र व य ल) है।

questions.question: Comprehension:गद्यांश पर आधारित निम्नलिखित प्रश्नों के उत्तर दीजिए इस संबंध में एक बात और ध्यान देने योग्य हैं। जिस प्रकार बाह्य शारीरिक कुरूपता मनुष्य के सौंदर्य बोध को कुंठित नहीं कर देती, प्रत्युत कभी- कभी और अधिक तीव्रता दे देती है, उसी प्रकार उसके बाह्य या अंतर्जगत की अपूर्णता उसे पूर्णता का सौंदर्य देखने से नहीं रोकती। ऐसा कुत्सित मनुष्य मिलना कठिन होगा, जिसके अंतर्जगत से पूर्णता की प्रत्येक रेखा मिट गई हो, सामंजस्य के सब रंग धूल गए हों।  साधारणतया घोर मिथ्यावादी भी सत्य को सबसे अधिक सम्मान देता है। मालिनतम व्यक्ति भी पवित्रता का सबसे अधिक मूल्य निश्चित करता है।  मनुष्य संसार के सामने ही नहीं, हृदय के एकांत कोने में भी यह नहीं स्वीकार करना चाहता कि वह मिथ्या के लिए ही मिथ्यावादी है, मलिनता के प्रेम के कारण ही मलिन है। प्रायः वह सब व्यक्तिगत अपूर्णताओं और विषमताओं का भार परिस्थिति पर डालकर, अंतर्जगत में प्रतिष्ठित किसी पूर्णता और सामंजस्य की प्रतिमा के निकट अपने आपको क्षम्य सिद्ध कर लेता है।  यह अपूर्णता से पूर्णता, यथार्थ से आदर्श और भौतिकता से सूक्ष्म तत्त्वों तक विस्तृत जीवन, काव्य और कलाओं की उसी परिधि से घिर सकता है जो सौंदर्य की विविधता से लेकर सत्य की असीम एकरूपता तक फैली हुई है। निम्नलिखित में से मिथ्या का विलोम शब्द बताइए
समाज के लिए अच्छे कार्य करने वाले लोग  ‘अमर’ हो जाते हैं । चिह्नित  शब्द का  पर्याय क्या  है?

निम्नलिखित मुहावरे का उचित अर्थ लिखें।आँखें सेंकना
questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'D' (दर्शन का सुख उठाना) है।

questions.question: प्रस्तुत वाक्य को सर्वोचित क्रिया विशेषण  शब्द से पूर्ण करें।_____ मैं सुबह में टहलता हूँ।

Comprehension:दिए गए गद्यांश के आधार पर निम्नांकित प्रश्नों के उत्तर दीजिए--  परवर्ती जैन साहित्य में रास ग्रंथों की प्रचुरता दिखाई पड़ती है। वस्तुत: रास नृत्य गीत और अभिनय के सम्पृक्त मनोभाव को सूचित करता है। रूप गठन की दृष्टि से प्रबंध और मुक्तक दोनों में रास काव्य लिखे गए हैं। प्रमुख रास ग्रंथों में ‘भरतेश्वर बाहुबली रास’(1184ई), ‘चंदनबाला रास’ तथा ‘उपदेश रसायन रास’ के नाम गिनाये जा सकते हैं। ‘भरतेश्वर बाहुबली रास’ शालिभद्र सूरि की रचना है। इसे हम कथा काव्य कह सकते हैं जिसमें कथा और गायन का विशिष्ट सम्मिश्रण है। इसमें रचनाकार ने हिंसा का विरोध किया है। ‘चंदनबाला रास’ में कवि आसगु ने नारी जीवन की करुणा को बड़ी सहृदयता से रचा है। इस काव्य से पता चलता है कि सामंती समाज में नारी की स्थिति कितनी दयनीय होती थी। रास काव्य में दूसरे प्रकार की रचना का उद्देश्य साहित्य का अंग है। इस प्रकार के रास साहित्य में सामाजिक व्यवस्था को सामने रखकर गृहस्थ को अपने धर्म का पालन करने का उपदेश दिया जाता था। जिनदत्तसूरि का ‘उपदेश रसायन रास’ इसी प्रकार की कृति है। इसका काव्य रूप चर्चरी कहा गया है। जैन साहित्य के मुक्तक काव्य में फागु की रचना भी मिलती है। फागु का संबंध फाल्गुन से है। वास्तव में फागु लोकगीत है। राजशेखर कृत ’नेमिनाथफागु’ फागु काव्य का श्रेष्ठ उदाहरण है। गद्यांश के लिए उपयुक्त शीर्षक होगा—
questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'C' (जैन रास साहित्य) है।

questions.question: 'बिजली' का पर्यायवाची शब्द है-
